data.name: CTRL+OPT+OUT
data.detailed_description:
PHOTOSENSITIVITY WARNING

This game contains bright lights, visual effects, and screen filters that could potentially affect photosensitive players. 

CTRL+OPT+OUT is a first-person netpunk zoomer shooter set in the distant present, an era where machines far outnumber man. Nothing human is making it into the future. Acquire hardware, take down adware, and fight your way across the network. 

WELCOME TO THE YEAR 20XX.

You are Combo. Your combo is your life. Combo constantly depletes. With every adversary you take down, you buy yourself some time to keep the fight going.

THE INTERNET IS FADING.

Dead Internet Theory? What’s that? Clear floors, gain points, and unlock new hardware to work with. Dual wield different weapons, mix and match equipment, and maximize.

TAKE BACK CONTROL. OPT OUT.

Explore vibrant locales, all of which have been chewed up by the system and spit out in dynamic order. No two playthroughs are the same and every copy is personalized.

FEATURES

  • You’ve got two hands, use them! Dual-wield pistols, revolvers, shotguns and more!
    (additional weapons coming soon)

  • Line ‘em up and knock ‘em down! Fight through a roster of 10 enemy types and counting!
    (additional enemies coming soon)

  • Featuring an eclectic, electric soundtrack played on shuffle to keep things fresh every time you dive back in.

ACCESSIBILITY

Key rebinding support, Mouse sensitivity slider, FOV adjustment sliders, volume sliders for SFX, UI, and Music

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 740 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Cup with a piece of string taped to the back
  • Additional Notes: Vulkan support required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTX 1050 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Vulkan support required

content_descriptors.notes: The main game play involves the character shooting enemies in a cartoonish manner. There is no gore/visible blood.
